name: Data Analyst

sections.daily_work: Collect, clean, and analyze data to find trends and patterns. Create dashboards and reports. Write SQL queries. Present findings to stakeholders.
sections.learning: Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, Python or R, data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI), statistics basics, storytelling with data.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $50,000-$75,000 USD. Mid-level $75,000-$110,000. Senior data analysts can earn $100,000-$130,000+. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Self-learning via online courses (Google Data Analytics Certificate, Coursera), statistics or math degree, bootcamps, building a portfolio of analysis projects on Kaggle.

try_in_real_life: Take a free SQL tutorial (try SQLBolt or Mode Analytics)
Analyze a public dataset on Kaggle or Google Dataset Search
Create a chart or dashboard in Google Sheets or Tableau Public
Follow data analysts on LinkedIn and read their case studies
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh); data industry salary surveys
